title: Consume pantheon-base-v0.18.2 into pantheon-ops
goal: Advance the Ops consumer from pantheon-base-v0.18.1 to the published pantheon-base-v0.18.2 so the tree carries the new shared menu-contract sensor, and repair what that sensor exposes on its first consumer run: 20 runtime-derived k8s permission title keys that resolve to no constant and no catalogue entry. Two pre-existing rebuild defects are repaired in the same pass so the next deterministic rebuild is lossless.
dependsOn: pantheon-base v0.18.2 release (tag object 2e32bd46, target commit a44ae4e0)
blocks: ops branch and pull-request closeout to main only

in: Update foundation-release.lock.json to pantheon-base-v0.18.2: release line, version, base commit, asset name, materialization path, bundle checksum and repo.tar checksum.
Rewrite .foundation/foundation-release.lock.json with the release identity, gate facts read back from GitHub, v0.18.2 pendingWork and notes.
Apply the rebuilt assembly to the live tree with an enumerated file copy, preserving the Dependabot bumps on frontend/package.json and frontend/package-lock.json.

Replace the init()-derived k8s permission menu seeds with static canonical-constant seeds, add the four missing k8sServicePerm* constants, the 16 missing frontend permission declarations and the 20 permission title translations.

Declare scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.mjs and its test as repositoryOverlayPaths, add both script names to opsOnlyScripts, and restore the two observability placeholder i18n keys into the v12locales sources.
Re-run every Docs Governance, harness and business gate on the applied tree.
out: Any change to the pantheon-base repository, an existing tag, a published release or its assets.
Hand-copying base files into the Ops source tree instead of materializing the locked release.
Any behaviour change in the k8s business module: menu membership, sort order, admin permission binding and route table stay unchanged.
Downgrading the Dependabot dependency bumps (i18next 26.5.11 / react-i18next 17.1.9).
Re-enabling check:task-packet in CI; the legacy allowlist remains a separate task.

doNotTouch: any existing tag, release or release asset

implementationNotes: The v0.18.2 delta is one shared path: frontend/scripts/check-menu-contract.mjs joins sharedPaths, so the manifest is backend 4 / frontend 47 / docs 2 = 53; the lock lists were verified byte-equal against the manifest inside the tgz.

The live replacement used an enumerated 14-path copy rather than a bulk archive overlay, because a wide-area overwrite was refused by the execution guard and because frontend/package.json plus frontend/package-lock.json must not be overwritten: the live tree already carries the Dependabot bumps i18next 26.5.11 / react-i18next 17.1.9 while base pins 26.5.6 / 17.1.3. The pre-swap tree was snapshotted to .tmp/backup-pre-0182/ (the untracked set was empty).

The new sensor parses Go seed struct literals. k8s_seed.go built permission menu seeds inside init() with titleKey := strings.ReplaceAll(item.perm, ':', '.') + '.permission', which is neither a resolvable constant nor an existing catalogue key (runtime spelling business.k8s.cluster.sync.permission). The frontend build failed with 后端 seed 引用了无法解析的常量: Key: titleKey twice. The fix removes the derivation and unrolls 20 static F menu seeds plus 40 zh-CN/en-US permission i18n rows on canonical constants.

The canonical keys surfaced 16 permissions the frontend module never declared (cluster sync/nodes; workload scale/restart/logs; namespace view/create/delete; configmap view/create/update/delete; secret view/create/update/delete); frontend/src/modules/business/k8s/index.ts gained those strings and the v12locales JSON sources gained their titles.

scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.mjs and its test were undeclared repositoryOverlayPaths and were not in opsOnlyScripts, so a clean rebuild would delete both files and drop check:gorm-sql-literal / test:gorm-sql-literal from package.json. Both paths are declared now and both script names survive the merge; the follow-up rebuild re-derived 789 files with no deletion.

business.observability.monitoring.field.endpointPlaceholder and ...urlPlaceholder existed only in the generated frontend/src/i18n/resources/business/*.ts files and would vanish on rebuild; both are now in the v12locales sources that generate them.

consumerSpecificControls: release identity read back from GitHub instead of asserted from the bundle
enumerated live-tree replacement after a wide-area overwrite was refused
deferredCodeIssues: Ops business modules still create their schema through AutoMigrate instead of a consumer versioned-migration channel; no such channel exists in base

Inherited base docs link to base-only task packets and the base evidence archive, so check:harness-docs reports dangling links in the consumer; the check is report-only and not part of the ops pipeline
Go race tests cannot run on this Windows host because ThreadSanitizer cannot reserve its shadow memory (error code 87); CI runs go test -race on ubuntu-latest

sensor-exposed defects repaired at their business owner

backend build/vet/gofmt/test on the applied tree
frontend lint/type-check/build with the menu-contract sensor reporting 40 menus / 50 routes / 237 permissions / 52 component keys
every Docs Governance, harness and business gate green on the applied tree
